messages:
alex_support: forwarding a customer escalation — their app intermittently gets schema validation errors when calling tools with binary payloads. says it works from Python but fails from TS/Go. pasted short repro below. SUP-3421

elena_support: customer says error: `400 ToolCallValidation: args.image: expected base64 string, got object` then tool selection falls back and ends up choosing wrong tool. they included request body.

alex_support: TS snippet they sent (works in some envs, fails in others):
```ts
// ts client v0.12.0
const img = fs.readFileSync('sample.jpg');
await client.callTool({
  name: 'ocr',
  args: { image: img } // passing Buffer directly
});
```

shawn_eng: hmm Buffer -> SDK serializer should turn Buffer into base64 string. but if some layer wraps with `{type: 'Buffer', data: [...]}` you'll get object. do we have any recent change to arg canonicalization? @rachel_eng

rachel_eng: quick check: TS SDK v0.12.0 added an experimental `preserveBuffers` option. default changed to true in a patch and serialized Buffers as `{type:'Buffer',data:[...]}` for debug. server expects plain base64 string. that explains why py (which encodes to base64 string) is fine.

elena_support: customer mentioned Go client also broke after bumping deps. they downgraded to older SDK and problem disappeared. they need workaround because this blocks their pipeline (P1).

shawn_eng: OK repro steps I ran locally:
1) ts client v0.11.3: Buffer -> base64 string: `args.image: "/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAAAQABAAD..."` -> server accepts.
2) ts client v0.12.0 w/ preserveBuffers true: `args.image: { type: 'Buffer', data: [255,216,255,...] }` -> server returns 400 validation error -> tool chooser fallback.

shawn_eng: minimal failing request body (as sent to our gateway):
```json
{
  "tool": "ocr",
  "args": { "image": { "type": "Buffer", "data": [255,216,255,224,...] } }
}
```

support-bot: linked logs from edge gateway for thread 2125554321: `validator: arg image: expected string(base64) got object` (x3).

rachel_eng: root cause hypothesis: SDK change + our gateway validator only accepts base64 strings for binary schema. two fix options:
- quick: accept Buffer-shaped objects in validator and convert to base64 server-side (backcompat).
- long: revert SDK behavior and release patch; update schema docs.

elena_support: customer asked for temporary client-side workaround. suggestion?

shawn_eng: workaround for TS/Go: ensure explicit base64 conversion before call:
```ts
// force base64 on Buffer
await client.callTool({ name: 'ocr', args: { image: img.toString('base64') } });
```
for Go: use `base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(bytes)` before passing.

alex_support: customer will try client-side workaround and report. they asked if we can fast-track a gateway hotfix to accept the `{type:'Buffer'}` shape — they can't change every producer right away.

rachel_eng: I'm creating ENG ticket: INF-7812. marking P1 for the gateway conversion shim. will add test vector for Buffer-object and raw base64.

shawn_eng: adding note: watch out for a slightly different failure where some TS runtimes prefix base64 with `b64:` marker (legacy). validator should tolerate optional `b64:` prefix too.

elena_support: customer replied: "wow thanks, trying workaround now" :thumbsup:

alex_support: will update thread after customer's verification. tagging @rachel_eng for the ENG PR once INF-7812 has a patch. :eyes:
